name: @aztec-avm-runtime/node-host
description: TypeScript bindings driving avm.wasm from Node.js on node:wasi
//: NO DEPENDENCIES, and that is the point rather than an accident.
The WASI half is node:wasi — Node's own, which supplies all eleven of avm.wasm's WASI
imports, and which upstream itself uses for the same job in
barretenberg/cpp/scripts/run_wasm_bench_node.mjs. bb.js's shim was measured and covers two of
the eleven; see src/loader.ts for the enumeration.
tsc comes from the nix dev shell, and the Node APIs used are declared in types/, so a clean
checkout can type-check and run this package with no npm install at all.
